# FileChecker
English | 中文

> A DSH plugin that puts a visible **Open location** button on every
> delivered-file card. One clic
k reveals the file in the system file manager.
## Why

A delivered-file card in DeepSeek Harness can preview the file, but revealing
its folder is buried i

nside the native-open menu. FileChecker promotes that
gesture to a labelled button that is always vi

sible, so a delivered report,
image, video, or Office document is one click away from Explorer, Find

er, or
the Linux file manager.
## What you get
Every `present` delivery card gets an action button with four states:
| State | Label | Notes |

| Idle | **Open location** | Calls the card's authenticated reveal gesture |
| Pending | **Opening…*

* | The Host desktop is handling the request |
| Success | **Located** | Returns to idle after 2 sec

onds |
| Failure | **Failed** | Returns to idle after 5 seconds; hover shows a retry hint |

- Hidden when the Host reports no usable native desktop, so there is no dead
button on remote or hea

dless deployments.
- Clicking the button does not trigger the card's preview overlay.
- Follows the

DSH light/dark theme through `--dsw-alias-*` tokens.
- Ships Simplified Chinese and English dictiona

ight/dark theme through `--dsw-alias-*` tokens.
- Ships Simplified Chinese and English dictionaries.
## Install
### From npm

ckage is prepared for npm as `filechecker`; until the first publish,

Or open **Plugins → Add plugin** in the DSH Web UI, enter `filechecker`, and
install the bundle. Ena
ble it if the dialog offers **Enable now**.
### From a local checkout
[代码示例省略，未执行]

The same local path can be entered in **Plugins → Add plugin**. Profiles with
HMR pick up the new bu

ndle without a restart; a profile without HMR asks for a
restart.
### Verify

Open any session that contains a delivered-file card (a `present` call from
this or a previous turn)

. The **Open location** button appears to the right of
the file name. Clicking it should open the co

ntaining folder and select the
file.
## How it works

The browser half registers one entry in the `deliverables.file.actions` child
slot declared by `@dee
pseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-deliverables`:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

The click calls the slot's own `onAction('reveal')`, which posts to the
already-authorized delivery

ick calls the slot's own `onAction('reveal')`, which posts to the
already-authorized delivery route:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

That route re-validates the Session, the delivery event, the file coordinates,
and the Host path map

ping. FileChecker **does not** add a Host route, copy a
file path into the page, or increase file ac

cess authority. The Host half of
the package is an empty `apply()`; it exists only so the bundle mou

nts and the
client manifest can discover `./client`.
## Compatibility

- Tested with **DSH 0.2.1-rc.2** on Windows 11.
- The reveal itself is cross-platform: it uses the H

ost's native file-manager
integration. The plugin UI is browser-side and theme-driven.
- Requires a

managed DSH profile. Without a reported native desktop, the action
hides instead of failing.
- `deli

verables.file.actions` is an internal contract of `ui-deliverables`. If
a future DSH renames or remo

ves that slot, FileChecker needs a matching
update; the button would disappear rather than throw.
## Development
No dependencies are required:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

The offline suite covers the manifest and patch, slot registration, dictionary
parity, unavailable-d

esktop hiding, pending state, the reveal gesture, style
disposal, and display metadata. See CONTRIBU

TING.md for the
local-install workflow and pull-request expectations.
## Limitations

- **Delivery cards only.** The changed-files review and the right-sidebar
document header keep their

built-in native controls.
- **The built-in control remains.** FileChecker adds a direct, labelled b

utton
beside it; it does not replace DSH's native open menu.
- **Generic failure text.** `onAction`

returns `revealError` without a reason.
Missing files and unmapped paths look the same in the button

; the Host route
owns the detailed status.
- **No file contents.** The plugin never reads or copies

ns the detailed status.
- **No file contents.** The plugin never reads or copies the delivered file.
